analyst.summary: J.B. Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals has already been legally merged into Torrent Pharmaceuticals (effective 8-Jul-2026, NCLT-approved), with erstwhile JB Chemicals shareholders having received Torrent Pharma shares (51 Torrent shares per 100 JB Chemicals shares, record date 17-Jul-2026) roughly three weeks before this review. Any current holding under the JBCHEPHARM ticker is, in substance, now a holding in Torrent Pharmaceuticals - this scorecard entry should be treated as a legacy reference pending removal, not an actionable standalone recommendation.
